Ambush on the Logging Road — Felled trees block the road. Before you can turn back, figures rise from the brush with drawn blades.
The Cold River — A wide, fast river cuts across the only clear path forward. The water looks brutally cold, and something moves beneath the surface.
Into the Wolf Den — The safer path leads straight through a den of territorial wolves, eyes glinting from the shadows of the underbrush.

The Sealed Ruin — Moss-choked stones form the entrance to a ruin far older than Hollow Ford. A sealed door bars the way, etched with symbols none of you recognize.
The Star-Etched Dial — A stone dial etched with constellations blocks the inner passage. Somewhere beneath the dust, a mechanism waits to be solved or broken.
Guardians of the Ruin — Bones stir in the dark as the disturbed mechanism wakes ancient guardians meant to keep intruders from the sanctum beyond.
The Glowing Grove — Pale lights drift between the trees of a hidden grove. Robed figures move among the glow, tending something that hums faintly beneath the earth.
